summary: Inter-process media plumbing received lifecycle and async fixes: the remote media engine is initialized exactly once and shutdown logic for the media engine child process was hardened to avoid leaks or races during teardown. Asynchronous promise handling for the CDM (the DRM child side) was also improved so DRM-related operations behave more predictably across process boundaries. These changes reduce crashes and race conditions when using encrypted media or when the media engine is started/stopped.
